def escape_latex(text: str) -> str:
    """Escape special LaTeX characters."""
    REPLACEMENTS = {
        "\\": r"\textbackslash{}",
        "&": r"\&",
        "%": r"\%",
        "$": r"\$",
        "#": r"\#",
        "_": r"\_",
        "{": r"\{",
        "}": r"\}",
        "~": r"\textasciitilde{}",
        "^": r"\textasciicircum{}",
    }
    for char, escaped in REPLACEMENTS.items():
        text = text.replace(char, escaped)
    return text
